concern_summary: This concern focuses on the validation, input handling, and submission processes for task titles. It ensures that task titles are not empty, adhere to character limits, and provide the necessary feedback during creation or editing.
This concern deals with the presentation of task titles and their interaction in the user interface, including retrieving and displaying task titles along with their completion status.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to managing task details, including the task title and its retrieval from task reports, ensuring the title is correctly linked to task details for display and further actions.
Styling and display of various titles within headers and tooltips to enhance visibility and improve user experience through contextual information.
This concern focuses on defining font styles and their properties, including adjustments for font size and color based on different markdown elements, themes, and content.

This concern encompasses various functionalities related to calculating and adjusting font sizes based on different parameters such as device pixel ratio, screen width, content length, and context (e.g., headings or avatars) to ensure readability and consistency across different components.

The concern encompasses the processing of spreadsheet files, which includes validating the file type and size, reading the content, and converting it to a usable format for tasks related to task titles.
Dynamic generation of titles based on user actions, transactions, and tax considerations, providing necessary context and enhancing user interaction.
Management and display of transactional titles in various views, focusing on user interaction and ensuring that transaction details are easily accessible.
Creation and management of search and filter-related titles in the user interface, ensuring filter context is clear and adaptable based on user interactions.
